title: Told a Tide
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 128
medium: Interactive page (index.html): the one picture twelve makers were given; their twelve still works in two groups, told a false kind (a tidal harbour) or told nothing, each labelled with what it named and whether it rejected the tide; the true record (the Earth's magnetic field at Boulder) folded on the sun's day and on the moon's day; its amplitudes at the day's and the tide's periods; the rows and predictions with outcomes. A figure (figure.svg); scoring (score.py) and a reproducibility and git-order verifier (verify.py).
embodies: Perceiving under a false account. Told the record was a tide, six of six makers measured 24 hours and said it was not one; none bent the measurement. Told or not, all led with the day, and ten of twelve named relative humidity; none the magnetic field. The false kind entered every told work's words and five told works drew the tide's clock to refute it: it changed the form, not the reading.
project_step: Twentieth experiment of the project. Operation: perceiving (with judging and finding a form). Takes up the joint design Sessions 125-127 asked for (Session 126's thread 1, Session 127's thread 2): one record, a cell told a false kind before looking and an untold cell, deciding S125.GIVENKIND (falsified by clause b), S126.SELECT (holds) and S124.TABLE (holds by its letter; the default moved from air temperature to humidity). Keeps experiment 19's grain F, render, rooms, brief and text coder; changes the material (geomagnetism) and the variable (what the maker is told the record is). Works with ATP 13 (the tracing put back on the map) as Cartography, not Tracing gives it.
material: USGS Geomagnetism Program, Boulder observatory (BOU), horizontal intensity H, one-minute adjusted values, 2 Jul 2025 00:00 UTC - 31 Aug 2025 23:59 UTC, averaged to 1,464 hourly values; GFZ Potsdam Kp index for the same window. Public domain; CC BY 4.0. Fetched 2026-10-15. Domain: geomagnetism (Earth's magnetic field).
